name: plan-view
description: Docked right-hand pane that shows the plan Claude writes, and Markdown files it mentions, as formatted markdown.

promptBand.title: Offer files above the prompt
promptBand.description: When on, Markdown files Claude mentions are offered in a band above the prompt with Open, Dismiss, Dismiss all and List. When off, they are offered only on the message card and in the list.
